name: comp-27

frames.best_why: The only frame where the magnifier has become a spinner, showing the loading behaviour while a query is typed.

tagline: A search bar whose magnifier turns into a spinner while you type.
summary: A labelled search field with a magnifier inside its left edge and a microphone inside the right. While a query is being entered the magnifier briefly becomes a spinning ring before settling back.
appearance: A label sits above a rounded dark search field on a black stage. A small magnifier sits inside the left edge, a microphone icon inside the right, and a grey Search... placeholder runs between them; typing adds a native clear cross before the mic.
behaviour: Typing swaps the magnifier for a spinning ring for about half a second, then restores it, while the query fills the field and a clear cross appears. The clip catches the spinner at pri and later shows pricing table settled with the magnifier back.
demo_content: Label Search input with loader, Search... placeholder, typed query pricing table.
search_phrases: box that shows a spinner while typing
magnifier that turns into a spinner
find products by speaking or typing
loading indicator inside a search box
quick search with a mic button
use_when: A search field that queries as you type and needs to show results are being fetched.
avoid_when: The microphone is a plain submit button with no speech wiring, so it only looks like voice input.
customise: The label and placeholder are fixed in the file; the 500ms delay, spinner and icon colours are set there, and typing drives the value.
weight_why: One field, two icons and a timer; the spin runs only during the brief loading window.

a11y.note: The spinner has a status role and both icons are labelled, but the mic does nothing and the spin ignores reduced motion.

issues: The microphone button has no click handler, so voice search is only an icon.
polish_why: Crisp field and a neat spinner hand-off, though the mic is decorative only.
title: Search Input With Loader
